hub.title: How we work with you
hub.lead: Contractual safari terms are agreed in writing when you book. Below: our published privacy policy, owner-draft pages for legal review, and a checklist for missing formal wording.
hub.professionalReviewNote: Booking, cancellation and governing law need review by a qualified adviser in Tanzania and your guests' home jurisdictions – we do not publish invented percentages or penalties here.

ownerChecklist: Confirm legal entity name and registered address for all policies
Provide final deposit schedule, payment methods and invoice terms
Provide cancellation tiers, refund rules and force-majeure wording
Confirm governing law and dispute resolution (Tanzania vs other)
Confirm whether FormSubmit.co remains the enquiry processor or move to owned SMTP
Decide on analytics (if any) and update privacy before enabling
Lawyer sign-off before removing DRAFT banners from booking/cancellation/terms pages
